# AbbVie

> > AbbVie is a global biopharmaceutical company with enterprise network infrastructure and authentication systems for authorized corporate access.

This site provides internal network access portals for AbbVie employees and authorized users. The infrastructure includes Citrix NetScaler AAA authentication gateways and Global Service Desk support for enterprise authentication and corporate network login.

## Key Topics

- AbbVie
- Global Service Desk
- NetScaler AAA
- Citrix
- authentication
- network-login
- corporate-access
- authorized-users
- netscaler
- citrix-gateway
- enterprise-access
- login-page

## Enterprise Authentication & Access

- [Network Login](https://cte.abbvie.com/): AbbVie network login portal for authorized users and Global Service Desk
- [NetScaler AAA](https://apps-d.abbvie.com/): Citrix NetScaler AAA authentication gateway for AbbVie enterprise access
